data.one_liner: Efficient, accurate, cross-platform metronome with volume, BPM, and audio source settings.
data.what_it_does: Provides a cross-platform metronome supporting adjustable volume, BPM, time signatures, and custom audio source settings. It includes tick callback streams and handles playback controls like play, pause, and stop.
use_when: You are building a music practice app that requires an accurate click track or metronome.
You need a cross-platform metronome supporting Android, iOS, Web, Windows, and macOS.
avoid_when: You need a full-featured general-purpose audio player or music streaming library.
You are looking for MIDI sequence playback or complex audio mixing tools.
strengths: Supports high BPM (>600) with good performance and low resource usage.
Cross-platform support including mobile, desktop (Windows, macOS), and web.
weaknesses: Limited to metronome functionality rather than general music playback.
Platform-specific audio session configurations may require manual tuning on iOS.
data.setup_notes: Configure audio assets and optional iOS audio session management if needed.

alternatives.name: audioplayers
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need general audio playback instead of a dedicated metronome.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you require advanced audio playback features like playlist management, looping, and precise streaming.
